claims.claim: The package manifest exposes index.ts as its only Pi extension and contains no license field.
Template loading rejects absolute and parent-traversal references, checks project prompts before user prompts, and reads model, thinking, and skill choices from frontmatter.
Chain execution resolves every template before starting, records the prior model and thinking level, and then advances through the ordered steps.
Rethrow mode accepts a bounded pass count, anchors at the current session leaf, supports plain tasks, templates, or chains, and delegates repeated execution to the rethrow loop.
Completion summaries collect recognized file reads, file writes, Bash call counts, and the last assistant text into a compact record.
The user command handles manual anchors, persistent guidance, optional tool enablement, task startup, busy-state rejection, and explicit cancellation.
The optional boomerang tool can queue an autonomous task or toggle a manual anchor and requests context collapse after the second anchor call.
Agent hooks inject boomerang instructions, wait for task completion, navigate the session tree, and combine summaries for rethrows or persistent anchors.
A session start restores saved model and thinking settings and clears boomerang state.
